rationale: Dated PDF register enumerating the licensed bank/PSP/e-money buyer universe; mine for leads, re-pull on reissue.
Top-level CBK payment-systems hub covering KIPS, oversight and participants; durable monitoring anchor.
KIPS scheme page sits under the payment-systems hub; valuable participant list but not standalone.
Oversight subsection of the same CBK payments hub; covered by monitoring the parent.
CBK tender/award notices name incumbent vendors and values — core A6 competitor signal, continuously updated.
Annual procurement plan gives forward-looking early warning of CBK IT and payments buys.
Master publications index feeding annual/financial-stability reports with named payment projects and partners.
Individual annual-report PDFs are evidence artifacts; the publications index is the producing source.
CBK time series quantify ATM/POS estate and card volumes — recurring addressable-market data.
One-off thematic card-usage PDF; strong evidence but not a continuing signal generator.
Regulations repository signals new licensable segments (non-bank PSP access, crypto) that create vendor demand.
Static primary statute PDF; background evidence, no ongoing flow.
Official Gazette is the canonical, continuously updated publisher of financial-sector laws; public and citable.
National e-procurement portal — superset of CBK tenders and the main vendor-award feed for XK.
Announcements hub is the parent of the already-kept tenders and plan pages; low marginal value alone.
Credit Registry subpage on bqk-kos.org; modest vendor signal, revisit if CRK procurement activity appears.
Language mirror of the same CBK CMS; useful sr-terminology route, not a distinct source.
Audited CBK accounts subpage, fetch failed; coarse capex proxy — recheck liveness later.
Banking association payments committee is a strong buyer-side source but URL fetch failed; recheck before approving.
ECB MIP news item naming Banca d'Italia as TIPS-clone supplier — key vendor fact, but a single press artifact.
Albanian trade press gives low-latency amplification of CBK licensing and project news; credibility modest, use as trigger.
Single law-firm briefing on crypto licensing; useful decode, thin as a monitored feed.
OCDS API publication gives machine-readable full award/supplier timeline for XK procurement — highest-leverage vendor source.
KRPP publishes annual procurement reports and rules; sizes the state IT/payments wallet and top authorities.
OSHP decisions name complainants and winners with technical/pricing detail — richest competitor mapping for XK bank/payment IT lots.
Legacy OSHP archive adds historical depth but fetch failed; recheck reachability before registry entry.
Central purchasing body whose framework awards gate multi-ministry vendor access, including IT and card services.
NGO-cleaned contract database gives pre-2016 history and company-level filtering as a cross-check on e-Prokurimi.
